name: canvas-reader
description: Read-only access to your own Canvas: deadlines, assignments, grades, announcements, Inbox, syllabi and course files, with source links. Runs on your Mac with your own Canvas token.

canvas_url.title: Canvas address
canvas_url.description: Your school's Canvas address, such as https://your-school.instructure.com. Leave blank to use ~/.config/canvas-reader/canvas.env.

canvas_token.title: Canvas access token
canvas_token.description: From Canvas > Account > Settings > New access token. Kept in secure storage. Leave blank to use the credential file or the Keychain.

timezone.title: Time zone
timezone.description: IANA time zone for due dates, such as America/New_York. Leave blank to use the credential file's TIMEZONE, or America/Los_Angeles.
